lines.zh: 我跟在两只同伴后面走
lines.en: I walk behind two of my pack.
The pack's steps land together.
I cross a cracked riverbed.
Neck forward, I test the wind.
My heavy stride crushes the low brush.
Three of us, walking one line.
My shoulders rise and fall steadily.
I take the flank and watch behind.
Claws bite the slope as I climb.
The lead goes first; I follow.
We skirt the standing stones.

lines.zh: 干燥的林地，脚步声很响
lines.en: In dry woodland my steps are loud.
I pause for the ones behind.
One tail swing turns the group.
I walk this ground once a day.
The hot wind carries my scent away.

lines.zh: 我抬头，看着远处的长脖子
lines.en: I look up at the distant long necks.
My pack dozes; I keep watch.
We wait for one that strays.
A deep sound rolls in my throat.

lines.zh: 我的牙一露，草丛就静了
lines.en: My teeth show and the brush goes silent.
This meal may take a long while.
We rely on numbers, not luck.
The soil underfoot is warm.
I wave a foreclaw at the flies.
Those two over there are far too tall.
No rush; the sun is still high.
Bite by bite, it will come down.
Who will fall behind today?

lines.zh: 我看一眼石柱，那是界线
lines.en: I glance at the stones; that is the border.
I fix on what you hold.

lines.zh: 我看你一个人站在空地。
lines.en: I see you alone in the open.
I tilt my head; my pack looks too.
You stand in the open.
Let us compare sizes.
I do not blink, teeth outward.
I have your scent now.
You are walking faster than before.
I will not roar; it is too loud.
You raised the torch higher.
I close the gap step by step.
All three of us are watching you.
I roar once and pull back.
My ribs feel dull and tight.
That slowed me.
Blood drips from my jaw.
I lower myself to guard my belly.
A packmate glances at me.
It hurts, but I am standing.
Thick hide stopped half of it.
I wobble, then steady myself.
That is noted.
That meat is too small to share.
Throw it over, then I decide.
The others smell it too.
I step back half; that is yielding.
Do not use food as bait; I know.
A big piece would be another matter.
This smells like leftovers.
I smell first; the pack eats first.
Bring one more piece.
We will share it without a fight.
I barge through without stopping.

lines.zh: 五十点生命的身体很沉
lines.en: A body this heavy does not yield.
You stagger back half a step.
I do not apologize; I keep walking.
My shoulder bone grazes yours.
We both sway.
Crowded together, neither gives way.
That felt like a swinging door.
I look down at you, then go on.
Do not block the pass.
Among packmates, a scent-nod suffices.
We stand side by side and raise our heads.
The whole pack guards this brood.
Two low calls settle it.
I do not push; I wait my turn.
She is quicker; I follow.
Hunting together beats sharing a kill.
We take turns on this nesting ground.
Same-pack blood smells alike.
No contest, no parting.
I stoop and take up the bone.
This is the leavings of a fight.
What lies on a kill belongs to the hunter.
I sniff; not meat.
It rolled to my feet; I pin it.
It will not fit in my jaws; I drop it.
This one is mine; do not grab.
I drag it to the nest edge.
Pack rule: first come, first kept.
Keep it for when hunger comes.
Two long necks; perfect.
Three of us; that will do.
Flank first, then press in.
That one has strayed.
My call carries; the pack will come.
The target is huge; this takes time.
The lead nods; we begin.
I take the left; two go right.
Its legs are the weak point.
This hunt may cost us lives.
We have lost such fights and won them.
Go for the legs, not the tail.

lines.zh: 地上的影子很长，方便靠近
lines.en: Long shadows help us close in.
No one charges first.
I circle behind it.
A packmate tires; I take over.
It turns slowly; we are quick.
Two were trampled; the rest of us remain.
I do not fall back; if I do, the pack scatters.
One more bite at the leg.
Blood is making it unsteady.
I run inside its shadow.
It lowers its head; dodge.
They called; help is coming.
We hold on, taking turns.
I misjudged that step.
The tail sweeps; I drop flat.
Hold on a little longer.
The dust of the hunt is thick.
I leap and bite the leg.
My teeth sink in.
The pack follows and piles on.
This bite tears hide.
Its hoof comes down; I dodge.
I wrench my head to tear deeper.
Something cracked.
My claws rake its flank.

lines.zh: 它流血了，我们流血更多
lines.en: It bleeds, but we bleed more.
Another bite; do not let go.
It drops a little.
My turn to press.
One tooth broke.

lines.zh: 它倒下的时候，尘土漫天
lines.en: When it falls, dust fills the air.
I walk out from behind the stones.
Three pairs of eyes catch the light.
We followed a scent here.
The lead ahead, me on the flank.
This hunting ground has been empty too long.
I flatten a clump of dry grass.
The long necks are still out there.
We lower our heads and sniff the soil.
A deep call rolls out.
The formation spreads, each taking a corner.
I need a spot out of the wind.
Our shadows merge into one.
A crunch underfoot—old bone.
We are in no hurry; we look first.
Another dry season begins.
I take my place in the middle.
This ground can feed three of us.
The wind carries blood, and water.
Fire scorches my spine.
I fall from the slope and hit my leg.
I sink and kick hard for the surface.
The blast rolls me over.
Something sharp is lodged in my shoulder.
Cold fire moves through my bones.

lines.zh: 饿起来，连同伴都让我紧张
lines.en: Hunger makes even packmates tense.

lines.zh: 雷落在背上，我的腿麻了
lines.en: Lightning strikes my back and numbs my legs.

lines.zh: 四周什么都没有，只有黑
lines.en: Nothing around me but black.
